note.after_visit_summary:
You have a sprained ankle from basketball. This is a mild to moderate sprain of the ligaments on the outside of your right ankle. We did not need an X-ray based on your exam. Your pulse was 70 and your blood pressure was 118 over 72.

Take ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth every 8 hours with food for 5 to 7 days, then take it only if you need it for pain. Rest, ice the ankle 15 to 20 minutes every 2 to 3 hours for the next 2 days, keep it raised on a pillow, and wear a compression wrap. We will fit you with a lace-up ankle brace to wear during practice for the next couple of months. You can use crutches for 2 to 3 days if walking hurts, but try to put weight on it. Do some ankle exercises by tracing letters with your toes a few times a day.

Do not play basketball for about 2 weeks. You can return when you can hop and run without pain. Watch for warning signs: if you cannot put weight on it, or the pain moves onto the bone, call us. If it is not much better in 2 weeks, come back and we will start physical therapy. You will get a note for school and gym class.
